## Problem

The A → B → A regression added with the same-root cursor fix failed on the Mac before exercising the installer. Each call to the shared publication helper made a fresh V5-to-V6 migration plan, which generates a random object address key. The third projection therefore had a different root identity even though the V5 source was unchanged.

## Change

Retain the first complete A projection and reuse that immutable graph for a new publication after B. A test-local helper constructs a new closure, intent, proposal, and actual Raft Stage/Publish using B as the predecessor and a new generation and index. It keeps the first plan's original absolute deadline and rejects expiry.

Only the new test module changes relative to `1c66541993662f92cf717154e33717abedb2ea74`. All 30 assertions, the intermediate B mutation and publication, and every byte from the third-root equality through the warm/cold repairs and final reopens are preserved. Production code and the original 60 test definitions are unchanged. This candidate includes the preceding same-root cursor fix from draft #158.

## Validation and limits

Pinned ROG rustfmt completed successfully with one child reaped, complete durable output, unchanged tool/config identities, and six independently version-pinned output reads. Root review verified all 3,914 source leaves and rebuilt all 358 Git trees: 3,913 leaves unchanged and one test changed.

The previous Mac candidate remains **60 existing tests passed + 1 new regression failed**; it has not been relabelled. The new candidate still requires actual Mac/Linux compilation and 61-test runs, followed by physical LAN failover, ReadIndex, restart, migration, and AuthBus validation. No production cutover or deletion is authorized by this PR.
